requirement: Personal data breaches must be notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours
Personal data breaches must be notified to the supervisory authority within 24 hours
Controllers must respond to a data subject's request within one month
Controllers must respond to a data subject's request within seven days with no possible extension
Public authorities must designate a data protection officer
Member States may not set the age of consent for children's data below 16
A data protection impact assessment is required where processing is likely to result in a high risk
Infringing data subjects' rights can lead to fines of up to 20 million EUR or 4% of worldwide turnover
Organisations must appoint a Chief Information Security Officer
Controllers must publish the source code of their data processing software
AI systems used for social scoring are prohibited

People must be informed when they interact directly with an AI system, unless this is obvious

Fines for prohibited AI practices are capped at 10 million EUR
AI providers must pay an annual registration fee per deployed system
